'''Biggs Field''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] training area on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[16 BBY/Legends|16 ABY]], a student crashed an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] and as a result three were [[Death/Legends|killed]] and sixteen were injured. In the same year, [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] trained [[Plat Mallar]] here.
